name: Openmart
summary: A local business database: search businesses and brands, with company enrichment from a website.

api_key.description: an Openmart API key (Openmart account > API management)

notes: Credit-priced; a 402 'Credit limit reached' means the team balance is empty. Check it with account.credit_balance.

Contact lookups (decision makers, company emails and phones, known people, tech stack) run as batch tasks that take a JSON array as the request body and return a batch_id to poll. The catalog's body model is an object, so they are not listed.
X-API-Key is accepted too, but Bearer is the recommended header.

endpoints.name: Get credit balance
endpoints.summary: Remaining team credits and the current billing period.

endpoints.name: Search local businesses
endpoints.summary: Find businesses by keyword, location and attributes (website, contact info, number of locations).

query.description: The type of business to find.

location.description: Where to search: objects with country, optional state and city.

has_valid_website.description: Only businesses with a valid website.

min_locations.description: Only businesses with at least this many locations.

cursor.description: The cursor of the last result of the previous page, [match_score, id].

estimate_total.description: Also return an approximate total; the answer is then {data, total_count}.

notes: A read over POST: the filters are in the body.
Page by sending the last result's cursor back as cursor.

When a record has contacts_locked: true, raw business email and phone are withheld; they come from the separate enrichment (task) endpoints, which this entry does not list because they take a JSON array as the body.

endpoints.name: Search business ids only (fast)
endpoints.summary: Same search, returning only id, place_id, match_score and cursor, at a reduced rate per row.

query.description: The type of business to find.

location.description: Where to search: objects with country, optional state and city.

has_valid_website.description: Only businesses with a valid website.

min_locations.description: Only businesses with at least this many locations.

cursor.description: The cursor of the last result of the previous page, [match_score, id].

estimate_total.description: Also return an approximate total; the answer is then {data, total_count}.

notes: A read over POST. Takes the same body as businesses.search.
Hydrating the rows later uses GET endpoints that need a JSON body, which this entry cannot send.

endpoints.name: Enrich a company from its website
endpoints.summary: Matching Openmart business records for a website.

location.description: Optional location objects to narrow the match.

notes: A read over POST. Rows have the same shape as businesses.search.

endpoints.name: Search brands
endpoints.summary: Brands (all stores sharing one business identity), deduplicated at company level; filter by term, location, store count and ownership type.

search_param.description: {search_term, location [{country, state, city}], num_stores [{ge, gt, le, lt}], ownership_type [INDEPENDENT, FAMILY, FRANCHISE, CHAIN]}. Location defaults to US when left out.

pagination.description: {limit (default 100, max 500), encoded_cursor from the previous response}.

notes: The response has encoded_cursor for the next page; empty on the last page.
